bio.text: Maurice Mercer is the Democratic candidate for Alabama's 6th Congressional District in 2026, running against incumbent Republican Gary Palmer.
He served on the Pelham City Council from 2012 to 2025.
He graduated from Midfield High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Troy University in 2004.
His career includes work in telecommunications, banking, retail management, organized labor, logistics and small business ownership, and he works as a business account executive.
